fact: AfriLabs lists Trustee Sas, an innovation center supporting ICT, renewable energy and agribusiness projects, and Incubateur Saboutech, a non-profit supporting SMEs and startups, as member hubs in Guinea, with no programme or cohort described.

Saboutech, described as Guinea's first incubator in Conakry, runs the #Tremplin one-year incubation and the #JePrendsMonEnvol 12-24 month acceleration, and says it has incubated 35+ startups since 2016.
Lengo Pay's director general says Guinea's support apparatus of incubators, hubs, contests and forums runs programmes judged on youths trained and workshops held, as reported by Business 360.
Minister Rose Pola Pricemou says a national technopole (Symphonia, 20 hectares) is being designed and regional digital hubs are being set up in each regional capital.
Orange states its Orange Fab incubation programme at Orange Digital Center Guinée launched a first cohort of five startups for six months of incubation, with laptops handed over on 9 August 2024.
